source_issue.title: Deployment documentation needs to show Seamless mode first, rather then classic "simple"

summary_markdown:
## What this issue is about
This issue highlights the need to reorganize the Plone Volto deployment documentation. Currently, "Simple deployment" appears first, but it is suggested that "Seamless mode" should be prioritized instead. This adjustment aims to clarify installation methods for different versions of Plone.

## What needs to be done
- Rearrange the deployment documentation to feature "Seamless mode" as the first option in the navigation.
- Ensure that the "Simple deployment" section includes a clear deprecation warning, indicating it is only suitable for Plone 5.2 and earlier.
- Update the "Simple deployment" content to provide relevant information without it being the primary focus.

## Helpful background
"Seamless mode" allows installation of Volto on older Plone versions without needing `plone.restapi` 2.0, while "Simple deployment" is becoming outdated. A refactor of this section is needed to make it clearer.

## Good first steps
1. Review the current deployment documentation at [Deploying](https://6.dev-docs.plone.org/volto/deploying/index.html).
2. Think about how best to reorder the items for clarity.
3. Create a draft for the proposed changes, including details for the deprecation warning.
4. Collaborate through comments if you have questions or suggestions!
